integrity: Exact linear algebra and analytic inequality proof. Included SymPy checker exercises symbolic identities and non-exhaustive finite parameter tests; results are not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact first-derivative three-node diagonal-norm results on a fixed symmetric grid; constant-mass uniqueness asserted only in first trigonometric frequency period. General PDE accuracy, non-diagonal norms and movable nodes not covered.
title: Sharp positivity and mass consistency for three-node function-space SBP differentiation
